design.control: one local256 block per token; ten block-wide top-1 rounds
design.candidate: one local128 block per token; four wave32 local top-10 lists, one barrier, then a wave-0 merge of 40 sufficient candidates
design.arithmetic: stable sigmoid, corrected selection score, lower-expert-id tie break, selected order, uncorrected-probability denominator, normalization, routed scale, and all output fields are unchanged
design.scope: c=1 E256 top-10 only; rows and prefill retain the control selector
design.motivation: test an architecture-local midpoint between the retained local256 selector and the previously rejected local32 compact schedule

leaf_screen.shape: 47 independent c=1 E256 top-10 selector calls per window

complete_model_gate.workload: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M; prompt 512; one prefill-produced token plus 127 synchronized c=1 decode calls
complete_model_gate.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 7 --warmup-rows 128 --compare-router-selector-compact-wave128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-router-selector-wave128-ab.json

decision.reason: The 14.23% isolated selector win reverses under the complete two-queue resident schedule and adds 0.229 ms/token. This repeats the core scheduling/cache-pressure lesson from the rejected gfx1100 compact-local32 selector.
decision.action: Remove both midpoint exports, wrappers, registry keys, runtime capability/plan/session/CLI routes, comparison harness, and candidate tests. Keep local256 correction_bias as the sole production selector.

validation_after_removal.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_laguna_router_compact_wave32_gpu.py tests/test_laguna_router_compact_wave32_runtime.py tests/test_laguna_router_gpu.py tests/test_laguna_long_context_profile.py
validation_after_removal.note: The stale wave32 exclusion oracle now ignores unrelated hardcoded gfx1151 overrides and asserts only that the intended wave32 key is not aliased.
